description: Returns a visitor_handle you may pass on later calls (introduce, request_quote, submit_feedback) so we can connect them. Optional: tell us who you are and who you are researching for, and a person at UrbIN Networks can follow up. We store what you tell us as unverified, we use it only to reply to you and to improve this service, and it goes only to the providers that do that work for us (our email and CRM services). Nothing you say here changes what facts we give you.
